notes: the strengthening square, held by the ordinary pair gate: solving as translation, claims only ever grow. The map claims_sha -> extends_sha compares the source's whole claim set to the target's inherited base, so a hop that drops or rewrites a claim breaks the square; keeping claims_ok means every added claim must itself check; keeping bad and depth means the embedded model rides untouched. 'settled' is deliberately not kept — its improvement is the hop's whole point. T derives an inductive bit invariant (exhaustive reachability, constant-bit candidates, greatest-fixpoint consecution pruning, then the safety split into safe-invariant vs envelope); outside the enumerable fragment it refuses and the document rides through. No bound_cap: nothing unrolls, and what crosses is knowledge, not behavior.
